name: Scroll of Messaging
summary: In Stonetalon, Gaxim Rustfizzle has a plan for the Scroll of Messaging. The gnome engineer means to use its sending spell to trigger remote explosives.

sections.title: A Volatile Message
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle plans to turn a message into a blast at the Venture Company's logging operation. He will combine the scroll's transmission incantation with volatile NG-5 charges. The explosion is meant to distract the guards, giving operatives time to slip past and steal engineering schematics and confidential correspondence.

faq.q: What is the Scroll of Messaging used for?
aliases: what does scroll of messaging do
faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle uses the Scroll of Messaging's transmission magic as a remote trigger. Paired with NG-5, it lets him set off an explosion from a distance.

aliases: where do i bring scroll of messaging
faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer in the Stonetalon Mountains, receives the scroll.

faq.q: Why does Gaxim need a remote explosive?
faq.answer: Gaxim needs a major diversion at the Venture Company operation. The chaos will cover an infiltration, the theft of engineering plans, and the recovery of documents meant to halt the company's clear-cutting of the forest.
NG-5 is an explosive chemical charge used by Gaxim Rustfizzle. Combined with the scroll's magical signal, it forms a remote detonator.

angles.text: The scroll shows how gnomish engineering can put arcane magic to use as a receiver for remote explosives.
For Alliance operatives, the scroll helps sabotage Venture Company machinery and hinder its destruction of the Stonetalon forest.
